faqs.a:
Section 309.1. Infestation,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
309.1. Infestation.
All structures shall be kept free from insect and rodent infestation. All structures
                  found to be infested by insects or rodents shall be promptly exterminated by approved
                  processes that will not be injurious to human health. After extermination, proper
                  precautions shall be taken to prevent reinfestation."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
